case.description: Forbidden-zone stuck reproduction WITHOUT physical contact. Four visible static walls (0.30 m tall, above the 0.107 m laser plane; 0.05 m thick, 0.90 m long) form a tight ~0.5 m cage centred on the start at (0,0). The 0.238 m body keeps ~0.11 m clearance to each wall, so there is no contact and no pitch; the costmap marks the footprint (0.18 m effective + inflation) as lethal and the global planner can never plan out of the cage, so the 25 s no-progress monitor fires the STUCK -> bounded escape -> resume -> re-STUCK chain cleanly. No global or local planner parameter is touched.
